Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of CoTe2/CoP on Ti mesh confirm that the characteristic peaks should be indexed to the CoP phase (PDF#29–0497), CoTe2 (PDF#89–2091), and metal Ti, respectively, as shown in Fig. 1b. As shown in Fig. 1f, the high-resolution TEM images demonstrate a contact interface between two distinct kinds of lattices, where the lattice distance of 0.163 nm and 0.223 nm are attributed to the plane of CoP (020) and CoTe2 (121), respectively.
